mapper.select: SELECT al.audit_log_id AS auditLogId, al.occurred_at AS occurredAt, al.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS userLoginId, al.action_code AS actionCode, al.entity_type AS entityType, al.entity_id AS entityId, al.before_value::text AS beforeValue, al.after_value::text AS afterValue, al.reason AS reason, al.request_id AS requestId, al.policy_version_id AS policyVersionId FROM fgc.audit_log al LEFT JOIN fgc.app_user u ON u.user_id = al.user_id WHERE ORDER BY al.occurred_at DESC, al.audit_log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.audit_log al WHERE
SELECT DISTINCT action_code FROM fgc.audit_log ORDER BY action_code
SELECT DISTINCT entity_type FROM fgc.audit_log ORDER BY entity_type
SELECT DISTINCT al.user_id AS userId, u.login_id AS loginId FROM fgc.audit_log al JOIN fgc.app_user u ON u.user_id = al.user_id ORDER BY u.login_id
